capabilities: Add new child headings under an INBOX section via a command
Add timestamped entries under a TIMELINE section via a command
Find or create the inbox and timeline headings in the target note
Configure the heading text used for both sections
Place the cursor in the new entry for immediate typing
extras: Manual installation only (extract release to .obsidian/plugins); no community plugin store instructions given.
motivation: The author built it to use with daily notes or project notes, to keep a running inbox and a running timeline of events.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly append timestamped or structured entries to dedicated inbox and timeline sections within a note.
summary: Command-based plugin that adds new headings as entries under INBOX and TIMELINE sections of a note.
